[LGRA.9.8.3] **`json()` is admitted in this edition as a test value only.**
The production `json("<str_lit>")` stays in the grammar. In a test block,
`json()` over one string literal is a test value ([LTSL.4.1]). Everywhere
else the compiler **must** refuse every `json()` call with
`DS_VALIDATE_JSON_LITERAL_REFUSED`: a rule's artefact has no form in which to
carry a `Json` literal, so no `json()` value could reach a `Json` slot or
argument.

The rules for its argument ([LEXP.6.4]) are deferred with it:
`DS_VALIDATE_JSON_NOT_LITERAL` and `DS_VALIDATE_JSON_PARSE_ERROR` stay
allocated and are not raised in this edition. In a rule the call is refused
first; in a test, [LTSL.4.1] states what the argument must be.
